pure-announcement.rationale: Reference documentation for an existing product feature, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: Agent Skills format and MCP extensions are adjacent distribution concepts, but none of the nearest concepts covers marketplace-based plugin discovery and install semantics.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every behavior described is checkable against the shipped CLI and its documentation.

durability.rationale: The page is dominated by version-gated behavior (v2.1.195/.203/.221/.232 caveats), cache-refresh mechanics and command flags that churn release to release; the durable residue (marketplaces as trusted catalogs with scoped installs) is thin.

actionability.rationale: It is all product-only steps — slash commands, CLI flags and settings — actionable solely inside Claude Code rather than shaping how anyone builds or decides elsewhere.

atomicity.rationale: A sprawling reference bundling marketplace sources, install scopes, auto-update cadence, LSP plugins and troubleshooting; none of the fragments stands alone as a concept and no single idea covers the whole.
